$comment: Crew-loop knobs (PLAN.md tooling item; system review 2026-10-13, flaw 7: rulings change the loop's behaviour through this file, never by editing the template). launch.mjs merges defaults with one crew's entry (objects merge one level deep; arrays replace), embeds the result and the crew's spec in the launched script, and refuses a crew marked draft. A ruling that changes a knob lands here through an orchestrator PR; prior-from-journal.cjs --refresh carries it into the next continuation. The mustFix quotes are word for word (crew-loop.check.cjs compares them with their sources).

gate.visitorPaths: the cold first visit of / at 1440 x 900 and 390 x 844, the EVF path (raise, frames, open a project, playback, close, honours, contact, lower), a deep link to /work/<slug>/, reload, Back and Forward, and the reduced-motion and no-WebGL paths
gate.frames: the engine frame counters from the ?vf-test stats (W-V0b), 3 runs each, from the build-once tree, plus the spec's own frame-count rows

mustFix.ruling: Owner decisions 2026-10-27 (system review, portfolio-evidence/loop-audit/SYSTEM-REVIEW-2026-10-13.md): website-first is reaffirmed (the Manor/project ion stays paused until the portfolio is live). The review's lean pre-launch crew model is ADOPTED for W-S2 onward: pre-launch must-fix taxonomy (block on acceptance-row failures, regressions vs main on default visitor paths, reproduced budget breaches, and slice design rows below target; pre-existing, rare-edge and tooling items go here by default); timed perf once per PR at the approval candidate plus once before G3a; 1 breaker pass by default (2 for W-F-m3); a design/motion jury with must-fix power on slices; waits of 270 s or less; a small versioned spec per crew. W-S2 cap: 3 code rounds plus 1 evidence round. No budget pause; each round still reports its cost. Slot 2's tooling PR now implements the review's quick wins before W-S2 launches.

taxonomy.label: Blocks
taxonomy.quote: a regression against main on a default visitor path, proven by a main-SHA control;

taxonomy.label: Blocks
taxonomy.quote: a budget breach beyond its tolerance band, reproduced in a second clean set;

taxonomy.label: Blocks
taxonomy.quote: on slices, a design row below target.

taxonomy.label: Rare edge
taxonomy.quote: Rare-edge regressions block only when the fix is at most one crew task with no new harness.

taxonomy.label: Queue
taxonomy.quote: Everything else goes to #91 with a done-when line: anything pre-existing on main, tooling hardening and single-run flakes.

taxonomy.label: Busy host
taxonomy.quote: A busy host means "blocked, rerun". It never means "cannot approve". A should-fix doesn't become a must-fix just because it recurs.

wv1.title: the project view and Flux's film prints (/work/<slug>/ as a real page, content model v3, the image ladder, prints sized by their images, playback)

jury.scale: 0 to 10 against the named references in the motion benchmark: 10 matches the best of them in quality (never their look), 7 is at the bar, 5 is competent but generic. The jury also checks north-star v2's 'never become' list

rows.row: Arrival: the frame becomes the page, and the roll arrives after the landing as part of the same exposure; exits are faster (refs: Jesper Landberg transition.webm)
The roll at rest: one curated set of mixed sizes that visibly follow their images, one focal mass, never a card grid or masonry template (refs: jury/flux/r2-work.png)
Focus: the AF brackets and the dim land on the print in under 100 ms and read as the EVF's own AF (ref: portfolio-zxc hover-crops.png)
Playback: it answers at once and lands in 0.6 s; paging and close feel firm
The blend: Flux's prints are recognisable and read as native to Viewfinder, never a second site pasted in (ref: jury/flux/06-open-sheet.png)

gate.visitorPaths: at 1440 x 900 and 390 x 844: (1) / then raise, frame 3, open, scroll, playback, page, close, Back, lower; (2) a cold /work/project-06/ (12 prints), scroll, playback, Esc, Esc; (3) the same with touch; (4) reduced motion; (5) WebGL off; (6) keyboard only; (7) JS off on /work/project-01/
gate.frames: draws in the roll at rest = 0 and at least 55 frames over the 1.1 s open at 60 Hz, from the ?vf-test counters, 3 runs; CLS over path 1; overflow

sets.row: Lighthouse on the built / and /work/project-06/ (mobile 10 runs, desktop 5) at the approval candidate, against the budgets-v2 section of budgets.md (proposed until the owner confirms, D-048)
